Card Q&A.a: It refers to the  "1 of your blue Digimon" that you select with this card's [On Play] effect.
Card Q&A.q: Does "that Digimon" on this card refer to the "1 of your blue Digimon" or does it refer to this card when played from digivolution cards?

Effect: [On Play] 1 of your blue Digimon gains ＜Jamming＞ for the turn. (This Digimon can't be deleted in battles against Security Digimon.) When played from digivolution cards, you may place 1 blue level 5 or lower Digimon card from your hand under that Digimon as its bottom digivolution card.
